284374132_2af9a9c2.text: Despite their functional importance, subicular glutamatergic neurons remain relatively understudied compared to other hippocampal regions, with only 6 of the 180 Hippocampome.org neuron types being from the subiculum, compared to more than 60 in the adjacent area CA1 (Tecuatl et al., 2025).

284374132_0534d2cf.text: Hippocampome.org uses axonal and dendritic morphology as a foundational approach to classify neurons in the rodent hippocampal formation, including dentate gyrus, Cornu Ammonis, subiculum, and entorhinal cortex
